description: Header file defining functions for creating empty tensors and computing storage sizes in the ATen library of PyTorch.

methods.name: check_size_nonnegative
methods.description: Checks that tensor size dimensions are non-negative.

methods.name: computeStorageNbytesContiguous
methods.description: Calculates the number of bytes needed for contiguous storage of a tensor.

methods.name: computeStorageNbytes
methods.description: Calculates the number of bytes needed for a tensor with given sizes and strides.

methods.name: empty_generic
methods.description: Creates an uninitialized tensor with specified size and options.

methods.name: empty_generic_symint
methods.description: Creates an uninitialized tensor with symbolic integer sizes.

methods.name: empty_strided_generic
methods.description: Creates an uninitialized strided tensor with specified size and stride.

methods.name: empty_strided_symint_generic
methods.description: Creates an uninitialized strided tensor with symbolic sizes and strides.

methods.name: empty_cpu
methods.description: Creates an uninitialized CPU tensor with specified size and data type.

methods.name: empty_strided_cpu
methods.description: Creates an uninitialized strided CPU tensor with specified size and stride.

methods.name: empty_meta
methods.description: Creates an uninitialized tensor with metadata, given size and options.

methods.name: empty_symint_meta
methods.description: Creates an uninitialized tensor with symbolic size and metadata.

methods.name: empty_strided_meta
methods.description: Creates an uninitialized strided tensor with metadata.

methods.name: empty_strided_symint_meta
methods.description: Creates an uninitialized strided tensor with symbolic size and metadata.
